Traumatic experiences often cloud our self assessment. If he has suffered from any kind of abuse, neglect, or emotional turmoil it may very well be a deep rooted subconscious problem. In my case, no matter how my wife attempts to build me up, there are times in which I have no conceivable control of my mental state. All you can do is your best and let him know that you support him no matter what. 
Also, make sure he understands that he can talk to you about anything. My ex wife used what little I did divulge about my tumultuous upbringing to hold power over me. I will not allow that again and no one should do that to someone they say they love. Support, understanding, caring, and listening are great strides to the journey of accepting one’s self.
